description: End-to-end lifecycle management for B2B unified communications tenants, including design, ordering, provisioning, modification, monitoring, and decommissioning.

tenant_id.description: Unique identifier for the UC tenant (customer instance).

design_id.description: Identifier for a saved UC solution design.

order_id.description: Identifier for a commercial or provisioning order.

site_id.description: Unique identifier for a customer site/location.

user_id.description: Unique identifier for an end user within a tenant.

subscription_id.description: Identifier for a UC subscription or bundle assigned to a user or site.

device_id.description: Identifier for a physical or virtual UC device (desk phone, SBC, soft client).

network_assessment_id.description: Identifier for a network readiness assessment job.

change_request_id.description: Identifier for a post-provisioning change request.

functions.name: design_uc_solution
functions.description: Create or update a high-level UC solution design for a B2B customer tenant, including sites, user profiles, voice features, and integration options.

tenant_id.description: Existing tenant to attach the design to. If omitted, a new tenant context is implied.

design_id.description: Existing design to update. If omitted, a new design is created.

customer_profile.description: High-level profile of the customer organization and requirements.

sites.description: List of customer sites to be included in the UC solution.

temporary_site_id.description: Client-side identifier for the site used only within the design.

user_profiles.description: Abstract user profiles to size the solution (e.g., knowledge worker, contact center agent).

profile_code.description: Short code for the user profile (e.g., 'KW', 'CC_AGENT').

features.description: List of required features for this user type.

regulatory_requirements.description: Special regulatory requirements for voice (e.g., emergency calling).

notes.description: Free-form notes or assumptions for the design.

functions.returns: Created or updated UC solution design with design_id and normalized sizing estimates.

functions.name: run_network_readiness_assessment
functions.description: Initiate or re-run a network readiness assessment to validate that customer sites can support the designed UC solution.

design_id.description: Design to use as basis for assessment.

tenant_id.description: Tenant for which the assessment is being executed.

sites.description: List of site IDs or temporary site IDs from the design. If omitted, all sites in the design are included.

schedule.description: Optional scheduling information for the assessment.

rerun_of.description: If provided, this assessment is a rerun of a previous network_assessment_id.

functions.returns: Network assessment job details including network_assessment_id and initial status.

functions.name: create_uc_order
functions.description: Create a commercial UC order based on an approved design and network readiness assessment.

network_assessment_id.description: Validated network readiness assessment to associate with this order.

package_code.description: Commercial code of the UC package.

target_profile_code.description: User profile this package is intended for.

number_management.description: Information about phone numbers to allocate or port.

new_number_requirements.description: Requirements for new numbers to be allocated.

auto_submit.description: If true, immediately submit the order for approval and provisioning.

functions.returns: New UC order details with order_id, pricing summary, and initial status.

functions.name: submit_uc_order
functions.description: Submit a previously created UC order for commercial and technical validation and trigger downstream provisioning.

submission_context.description: Context and approvals collected for order submission.

submitted_by.description: User ID or email of the submitting party.

functions.returns: Order submission confirmation with updated order status and any validation warnings.

functions.name: provision_tenant
functions.description: Provision the UC tenant and core services based on an approved order.

tenant_id.description: If not yet allocated, a new tenant will be created.

site_provisioning_plan.description: Optional plan if provisioning is phased by site.

admin_accounts.description: Tenant administrator accounts to be created.

integration_settings.description: Initial configuration for integrations (e.g., SSO, directory sync).

dry_run.description: If true, validate provisioning steps without making changes.

functions.returns: Provisioning job summary including tenant_id (if newly created), job identifier, and initial status.

functions.name: assign_uc_users_and_devices
functions.description: Bulk assign users, subscriptions, numbers, and devices under a tenant after core provisioning.

assignment_batch_id.description: Optional client-specified batch identifier for idempotency.

users.description: User assignments to be created or updated.

external_user_ref.description: External reference or login name from customer directory.

user_id.description: Existing user_id if updating an existing user.

numbers.description: Phone numbers to assign to the user.

devices.description: Devices to bind to the user.

conflict_resolution.description: Strategy if user or number already exists.

functions.returns: Assignment job summary with per-user acceptance, conflicts, and any deferred tasks.

functions.name: get_tenant_status
functions.description: Retrieve the current lifecycle status and health of a UC tenant, including key KPIs and open issues.

include.description: Additional details to include in the response.

functions.returns: Tenant lifecycle status, provisioning state, and optional summaries for sites, users, and orders.

functions.name: list_uc_orders
functions.description: List and filter UC orders for a tenant or across tenants, with pagination.

parameters.returns: List of UC orders matching the filter with pagination metadata.

functions.returns: List of UC orders matching the filters with pagination details.

functions.name: create_change_request
functions.description: Create a post-provisioning change request for a tenant, such as modifying user features, adding capacity, or changing sites.

requested_by.description: Identifier or email address of requester.

change_details.description: Change-specific details; structure depends on change_type.

functions.returns: New change request with change_request_id, status, and any required approvals.

functions.name: approve_or_reject_change_request
functions.description: Approve or reject a pending change request with optional conditions.

conditions.description: Optional conditions or notes related to the approval or rejection.

functions.returns: Updated change request status, including any scheduled implementation windows.

functions.name: retry_or_rollback_provisioning
functions.description: Retry failed provisioning tasks for a tenant or roll back to a previous stable state.

order_id.description: Order associated with the provisioning tasks.

target.description: Specific target of the recovery action.

checkpoint_id.description: Checkpoint to roll back to, if mode is rollback_to_checkpoint.

step_ids.description: Specific provisioning step IDs to retry, if mode is retry_specific_steps.

functions.returns: Recovery operation status, including any new task IDs and the resulting tenant lifecycle state.

functions.name: suspend_or_resume_tenant
functions.description: Temporarily suspend or resume UC services for a tenant, with configurable scope and schedule.

scope.description: Scope of the suspension or resume.

services.description: Services to affect; if omitted, all UC services are included.

schedule.description: When to execute the suspend or resume action.

functions.returns: Suspension or resume request details with status and any impact notes.

functions.name: decommission_tenant
functions.description: Permanently decommission a UC tenant, including optional data retention and export settings.

data_retention.description: Policies for retaining or deleting tenant data.

exports.description: Data exports to prepare before decommission.

functions.returns: Decommission request details with planned execution window and tracking identifiers.
